frameworks: Cayman Islands Y5 Expectations (island geography focus)

objectives.description: Use maps, atlases, globes and digital mapping to locate countries and describe features studied
Use symbols and a key (including the use of Ordnance Survey maps) to build knowledge of the UK and wider world
Use four-figure grid references and understand latitude and longitude
Describe the distribution of natural resources including energy, food, minerals and water
Explain human impact on the environment, including climate change and its effect on small island nations such as the Cayman Islands
Describe how coral reefs and mangroves protect coastlines and support biodiversity
Locate the world's countries, focusing on the Caribbean, Europe and North/South America, and their environmental regions
Describe climate zones, biomes and vegetation belts, and understand key aspects of physical geography including hurricanes and volcanoes
